_comment: Shadow/target branch-protection config for the dev branch. scripts/branch-protection-apply.sh consumes it as a local bridge artifact only; P0.0 records live drift and this file is not Phase-0 exit authority until a trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci producer is live and applied.

required_status_checks._strict_rationale: Set to false per ADR-0124 to break the O(N^2) rebase cascade; the merge bridge enforces required status contexts without GitHub-side up-to-date enforcement.
required_status_checks._oya_pr_review_note: oya-pr-review is intentionally absent from protected contexts. The repo-owned GitHub adapter producer contract exists, but controller deployment, trusted credentials, oya-ci-required fan-in wiring, branch-protection application, and live PR API readback remain external prerequisites.
required_status_checks._phase0_target_note: P0.0 target required context is oya-ci-required, posted by oya-ci-controller from trusted controller/trunk state. Legacy cargo/* and oya-verify contexts may remain migration feedback only, not protected-branch merge or Phase-0 exit authority.

_required_pull_request_reviews_rationale: GitHub human approving reviews are not merge authority for dev. oya-pr-review is future/non-live reviewer evidence only until its producer is live and explicitly required; keep this null so branch-protection re-application cannot recreate the hidden requiresApprovingReviews=true/count=0 blocker that stalls the next queue.
_phase0_p0_0_note: Destination authority is oya-ci-required produced by trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci control state; this checked-in target is not a live-enforcement claim until the ruleset is applied and the producer posts on the candidate SHA.
